author: Atheyna
body:
Map Name: Coconut Walls
Creators: Flufflepuff_ 
Gamemode: The Walls
Features:
- Many secret hidden chests and locations to explore
- A jungle mineshaft to mine some ores.
- Giant Mountains!
- Palm Tree styled map.
- 5v5v5v5
- Yellow Team, Purple Team, Blue Team, Lime Team.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Love to see new walls maps. Keep them coming :)

One thing if its 15 v 15 v 15 v 15 - we normally only have 2-4 per team, so I don't think the 15 v 15 v 15 v 15 will happen. 40 is as many as I have ever seen on a map, and that was a year ago. No idea if the map is set to provide ore, supplies, etc for that many players, if it is, the 2-4 players  per side are going to be really geared.
